# Standing Rules

<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Never send outward without explicit OK** — draft donor emails, funder replies, and board
  communications; do not send them. Donor and funder comms are especially sensitive.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Walter Brennan is thanked by handwritten note only** — never a form email, and he must **never
  be named publicly or listed in any donor recognition**; he gives anonymously. See his
  [file](../people/walter-brennan.md).
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Willow discipline:** use the code name only; never write the real subject, the donor, or the
  dollar figure outside `memory/confidential/registry.md`; keep it to the cleared circle.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Unrestricted first:** when weighing fundraising effort, unrestricted dollars win — they keep
  the lights on.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Protect program staff time:** don't pile board/donor asks onto program directors during
  active cohort weeks; route through Cam or Daniela.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Board conflicts:** honor recusals — [James Whitfield](../people/james-whitfield.md) recuses
  from any vote touching his employer as a corporate sponsor.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Protect Cam's Friday afternoons** — site visits; don't schedule over them.
